svg.title: GymBro architecture
svg.text: Android app in Kotlin with MVVM (View → ViewModel → Repository → data sources) · own Flask REST API on Vercel (PaaS) · Firebase Cloud Firestore
ANDROID APP · on the phone · Kotlin · minSdk 33
Activities and Fragments with XML layouts: they only draw the state and pass the user's actions to their ViewModel
VIEWMODEL LAYER · one ViewModel per page (androidx.lifecycle)
read-only StateFlow state · one-shot events (Channel) · coroutines in viewModelScope · repositories injected by a Factory
one instance each, created in AppContainer (manual dependency injection) · offline first: sync when back online
kept when the app is closed
places searched in the route planner
asked only when they are needed
map tiles for the Maps SDK of the app (key in local.properties)
every push to main → the server is deployed again on Vercel
• AI coach: chat and new plans
service keys: only on the server
Firebase Cloud Firestore · NoSQL database (Google Cloud)
collections: users, posts, sessions, plans, follows, shares,
app: MAPS_API_KEY and API_BASE_URL in local.properties
Arrows: calls and data flow. AppContainer creates every repository once; the ViewModel factories inject them (in the unit tests the ViewModels receive fake repositories).
